name: animated-tabs-bar
title: Animated Tabs Bar
description: Switch between views; the highlight glides to the active tab.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. The Primary pill and the underlines use its primary colour; any theme but Default also tints the active tab's text with the underline styles.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette.

props.name: activeIndicator
props.label: Active indicator
props.description: How the active tab is marked: a pill or underline that glides to it, or an underline that fades in.

props.name: activeColor
props.label: Active tab colour
props.description: Colour of the gliding pill. Only used by Glide pill.

props.name: hoverHighlight
props.label: Hover highlight
props.description: Highlights the tab under the pointer.

props.name: divider
props.label: Line under tabs
props.description: Draws a line under the row of tabs.

props.name: listBorder
props.label: Border on tabs
props.description: Draws a border around the row of tabs.

props.name: panelBorder
props.label: Border on content
props.description: Draws a border around the tab content.

props.name: rounded
props.label: Roundness
props.description: Corner radius of the tabs, the pill and the borders.

props.name: contentAnimation
props.label: Content animation
props.description: How content changes when you switch tabs.

props.name: slideDistance
props.label: Slide distance
props.description: How far content slides when switching tabs, in pixels. Needs Content animation set to Slide.

props.name: smoothHeight
props.label: Smooth panel height
props.description: The content area animates to each tab's height instead of jumping.

props.name: fadeDuration
props.label: Fade duration
props.description: How long the fade takes, in seconds. Needs Content animation set to Fade in / out.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long the indicator and content take to move, in seconds.

props.name: bounce
props.label: Bounce
props.description: Springiness of the indicator and slide. Does nothing with Fade underline unless Content animation is Slide.
